name: Tyrande and Remulos
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Tyrande will be notifed, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.

Now you must venture to the Moonglade and speak with Remulos. He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.

We all wish you great luck.
narrative.objectives: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.
narrative.offerRewardText: It would be impossible to pull Eranikus from the Dream should he refuse. His intentions, however, require him to enter our world. He seeks to destroy the living manifestation of Malfurion. To do this successfully would mean an end to one of the most powerful allies of the Dream. The Nightmare would wholly consume all that would remain should Malfurion fall...

chain.subtitle: 8 quests at level 60, 47,950 XP in all.

quests.name: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the continent of Teldrassil and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of Darnassus.

quests.name: Tyrande and Remulos
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.

quests.name: The Nightmare's Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each.

quests.name: The Champion Returns
quests.objectiveText: Take the Green Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
